newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela muni taxes should be 1.5-2 pct - Romero.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela muni taxes should be 1.5-2 pct - Romero.

text.p: Municipal taxes paid by foreign companies working in Venezuela should be set at 1.5-2 percent, deputy Energy and Mines Minister Evanan Romero said Wednesday.
State-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela has set a four percent cap on municipal taxes in the third round of oil operating licences, which Romero described as "high".

"Four percent is just a safety factor that PDVSA will reimburse because they know that some municipalities go out of the norm... One and a half or two percent is fair, that is what has traditionally been an average," he said.
Municipal taxes are unpopular with foreign investors because they can rise suddenly at the discretion of local authorities and are payable on gross revenues.
